result.summary: The screen is mostly well-structured, but exhibits minor styling inconsistencies and subtle contrast issues.

issues.description: Favorite heart buttons across feed cards have inconsistent styling; one has a circular background container while the other does not.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button component across all listing cards.

issues.description: Subtitle text in the promotional banner has low contrast against the lighter green background.
issues.suggestion: Darken the banner background or adjust text color to meet readability standards.
